group.doc: Group name, pattern, or viewport selection to split. Empty or unmatched selection leaves the input unchanged.

group_type.doc: Domain of the selection. A face is a primitive; point or edge selections retain faces whose every point or edge is selected.

invert_selection.doc: Swap the selected and remaining pieces when the group contains elements.

delete_unused_groups.doc: Remove group attributes with no members from each split piece.
